title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 225 ]

blocks.text: Some people insist on “love at first sight,” but I suggest that they calm down and take a second look. There is no such thing as love at first sight. Some of those attractive first－sight qualities may turn out to be genuine and durable, but don't count on the storybook formula.
The other saying, “love is blind” is far more sensible. The young girl who believes herself to be in love can't see the undesirable qualities in her man because she wishes not to see them.

readingSentences.english: Some people insist on “love at first sight,” but I suggest that they calm down and take a second look.
readingSentences.korean: 어떤 사람들은 '첫눈에 반하는 사랑'을 주장하지만, 나는 그들이 진정하고 다시 한 번 살펴보기를 권한다.

readingSentences.english: There is no such thing as love at first sight.
readingSentences.korean: 첫눈에 반하는 사랑 같은 것은 존재하지 않는다.

readingSentences.english: Some of those attractive first－sight qualities may turn out to be genuine and durable, but don't count on the storybook formula.
readingSentences.korean: 첫눈에 매혹적으로 보이는 특성들 중 일부가 진실되고 오래 지속되는 것으로 밝혀질 수도 있겠지만, 동화 같은 공식에 너무 기대지는 마라.

readingSentences.english: The other saying, “love is blind” is far more sensible.
readingSentences.korean: 또 다른 격언인 '사랑은 눈을 멀게 한다'는 말이 훨씬 더 분별력 있는 통찰이다.

readingSentences.english: The young girl who believes herself to be in love can't see the undesirable qualities in her man because she wishes not to see them.
readingSentences.korean: 스스로 사랑에 빠졌다고 믿는 젊은 여성은 그 남자의 바람직하지 않은 단점들을 보고 싶어 하지 않기 때문에 그것들을 보지 못하는 것이다.
